title: Stemless plastic wine glasses
text: Stemless plastic wine glasses. Bought these for family gatherings we have.. they are a nice size and could be used for drinks other than wine as well.  They are plastic and lightweight.. but sturdy too.  Chinet is a good brand in my mind and these are representative in my opinion. They are crystal clear.  I never hesitate to update my reviews if new info would seem useful.
